analysis: Final public-data test of shared human-screening errors against a separate expert reference
status_when_written: After source/schema checks and before root performance computation; not preregistered or outcome-blinded to the published article
reference: The main Results CSV Relevant field, corresponding to the original experts' title/abstract screening decisions. This reference precedes and is separate from the evaluated crowdworkers. It is not a newly blinded adjudication.
full_text_endpoint: Not analyzed: inconsistent source exports including Omega3 108 versus paper 144 positives and internally conflicting ProtonBeam labels. Stage-specific controls are preserved in source_integrity.json.
source_filter: Remove Honeypot==1 and precisely the blocked WorkerIds listed in each frozen original processing R script. Preserve a sensitivity including all non-honeypot workers.

criterion_mapping.numeric: Appendicitis Question2 and ProtonBeam Question4: a finite unambiguous decimal >=10 or exact NoInfo retains; numeric below10 fails. Do not semantically repair malformed strings.
criterion_mapping.worker_decision: Derive a conjunction of required eligibility answers: any explicit failure excludes; every criterion passes to retain; otherwise unresolved. Missing questions after a known failure do not invalidate an exclusion.
criterion_mapping.unresolved_primary: Exclude the unresolved worker decision only, retaining the item when >=2 distinct valid workers remain.
criterion_mapping.unresolved_sensitivity: Separately assign all unresolved worker decisions to Exclude and all to Retain, with no reference-dependent imputation.

estimand: For each item choose uniformly from all unordered pairs of distinct eligible observed workers. Each item has total weight1 regardless of number of available pairs. This is a retrospective finite-record policy expectation, not an observed pair assignment or an executed human workflow.
policies: single: uniformly selected observed valid worker
AND: retain only if both derived decisions retain
OR: retain if either derived decision retains
ideal_disagreement_review: replace only pair-discordant decisions with the fixed expert reference; leave agreements untouched
outcomes: Exact rational expected TP,FP,FN,TN and their descriptive recall,precision,specificity and retained fraction
Expected record fraction with pair disagreement and reference composition
Shared false exclusion and shared false retention under separate reference
Number of reference-positive/negative items unanimously misclassified by every retained crowdworker, restricted to items without unresolved votes
inference: No p-values, no independent-pair binomial confidence intervals, no treating pair combinations as additional studies or participants. Review-specific descriptive findings are primary; any aggregate is merely the sum of these convenience samples.
claim_boundary: Human crowd decisions and a separate original expert reference only. No LLM was rerun, no human correction executed, no person-time benefit established, no claim that the expert reference is error-free. The crowd questions were deliberately broader than the expert criteria. Original paper p1 aggregates per-question votes and is not identical to this per-worker conjunction replay.
manuscript_action: Keep R47 unchanged during this final test. Admission to a later manuscript requires a separate editorial decision based on the verified result.
